C0354.title: Zhejiang Company Ordered to Pay 350,000 Yuan for Obtaining Data via Credential Stuffing
C0354.summary: Hangzhou Internet Court publicly announced its judgment in an unfair-competition dispute brought by Hangzhou Company A and Hangzhou Company B against Zhejiang Company C. The court found that the defendant had used credential stuffing for about six years to illegally obtain and use accounts and passwords for the “Women’s Wear Network,” log in, and view distributor database information. It ordered the defendant to stop the infringement, pay the two plaintiffs 350,000 yuan in economic losses, and bear civil liability for eliminating the impact.
